response.description: Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager is now in public preview, offering a unified, goal-driven experience to design, assess, and improve application resiliency across Azure. It brings together capabilities across Availability Zones, Azure Advisor, Chaos Studio, Azure Monitor, and Copilot into a single workflow for end-to-end resilience. With AI guidance, actionable recommendations, and built-in drills, organizations can proactively build, improve, and validate resiliency end to end.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager
